answer: A falcon needs open sky, not a longer leash. Give every identity an emission that halves for each epoch it stays silent, and let new names open at zero rather than at parity: a swarm of fresh keys lands on the ledger as a tide that never rises, since payouts size to tenure-weighted participation, not headcount. One vine grown over seasons out-earns a thousand cuttings planted the same night, and the ledger stamps root depth, so grafts off a single stock share one root. Forging more names buys more silence, never more voice. Honest newcomers still climb: slowly, visibly, permanently.
